import pytest

    job_b = Job("B", dependencies=["A"])
    job_c = Job("C", dependencies=["B"], should_fail=True)
    job_d = Job("D", dependencies=["B"])

    jobnet = JobNet(jobs=[job_a, job_b, job_c, job_d])
    jobnet.run_jobs()
